feeds.title: Indian Luxury Trains Blog
feeds.description: Indian Luxury Trains (ILT) is India's first and only luxury train travel portal serving as a trusted resource for luxury train traveling in India and add-on tours for exclusive Indian holidays. Their blog sports a vivid collection of stories, tips, and insights related to expensive train journeys. Read the latest posts now!

feeds.title: Rail Data India
feeds.description: Shamim Ansari from Chandauli UP writes this blog to provide information to people about Indian Railways. Here you will lot of information about the working system of Railways like the Railway's current projects, circulars, rules, trains, PNR status, enquiries, codes, manuals, e-office, HRMS, etc. This blog is very beneficial for the railway employees as well as the common people.

feeds.title: Rail News Center
feeds.description: Rail News Center is a Railway Employee Portal for Railway and employee information. It provides Information and news on Rail Users / Employees i.e Travel, Trains, facilities, Rules, manuals, Circular, transfers, Link for Salary, Pay Slip, and a huge number of other topics.

feeds.title: Rail Analysis India
feeds.description: Stay well-informed with the latest on-goings of the Indian Railway industry with news articles and opinions shared by Industry professionals. Rail Analysis India is the largest networking group, in India, providing top-of-the-line consultancy projects to Railway Experts and Professionals.

feeds.title: RailPost
feeds.description: Get the latest news, analysis, and insights on Indian Railways. Topics ranging from Operations, Organisation, Technical aspects, high-speed rail, metro & suburban rail, Infrastructure, Projects, and regular updates are featured here. RailPost is a premier Railway news and analysis website covering the Indian Railways.

feeds.title: Rail Ministry
feeds.description: Rail Ministry keeps you updated with what is happening in the Railway. Subscribe for the latest updates and know about various Railway Services. Find detailed articles on new research and development, technology and more.

feeds.title: Commercial Guide Indian Railway BlogBlog
feeds.description: Commercial Guide Indian Railway Blog is an internet resource for candidates preparing for Railway Examination services and provides Study Material, Guide, and Notes of commercial department Indian Railway for Departmental Examination & General Studies.

feeds.title: redBus Blog » redRail
feeds.description: This section of the redBus blog is dedicated to Railway travel. Browse detailed guides on how to book train tickets, newly-announced special trains, routes added, best places to visit via railways, and many more exciting facts about Indian trains. redBus is the world's largest online bus ticketing platform.

feeds.title: Railofy Blog
feeds.description: Keep up with the times with useful Train Travel Tips, Info and More. Railofy is your one-stop for all your Train Travel needs. Their services include Train Ticket Booking, Ordering Food in the Train, Checking IRCTC PNR Status, and More.

feeds.title: RailRecipe Blog
feeds.description: The blog talks more about the Indian food, recipes, its availability while travelling and much more. RailRecipe is an official IRCTC e-catering partner that offers safe and tasty food on train in no time directly at your train seat, following all the hygiene and safety protocols from our FSSAI & IRCTC approved restaurant vendors to satisfy your hunger.

feeds.title: Rani Kamalapati Railway Station Blog
feeds.description: Find detailed guides about Trains, Travel guides, and What to expect on specific routes and in the Rani Kamalapati Railway Station blog. Rani Kamalapati is one of the first modern high-class railway stations in India built with ultra-modern amenities like a large covered parking area, 24X7 power backup, drinking water, an air-conditioned lobby, offices, shops, and other features.

feeds.title: Orient Rail Journeys Blog
feeds.description: Embark on a lavish journey with the Orient Rail Journeys Blog - a collection of travelogues across India's most luxurious trains. Read stories that often provide a vivid and immersive account of travel experiences, describing the landscapes, people, and cultures encountered along the way.

feeds.title: Railway Signalling Academy Blog
feeds.description: Deep dive into the intricate workings of the Indian Railway Signalling System with detailed articles. Railway Signalling Academy is a digital platform educating Indian readers, especially Railway candidates about Signalling knowledge like all types of Electronics Interlocking, Signalling Circuit exploration, and Logic Design Processes.
